newsitem.title: USA: Wilson Sporting reduces corporate, golf group.
newsitem.headline: Wilson Sporting reduces corporate, golf group.

text.p: Wilson Sporting Goods Co said Thursday it is reducing the size of its corporate group and golf division, effective immediately, in a move to boost profitability.
It said 85 positions in Wilson's Chicago-based corporate group and golf divisions are affected. The company employs more than 3,000 worldwide.
Of the total, 15 positions are in the company's Humboldt, Tenn., golf ball plant.
President Jim Baugh in a statement said Wilson will not eliminate any categories in its current golf line and will continue to offer club, ball, bag and accessory products.
Baugh noted that the company's golf division has not achieved its profit objectives for the past few years, in contrast to the more successful team sports and racquet sports divisions.
